log.action: date -> datetime (renamed sale_date), zipcode -> text, other columns checked as numeric
log.reason: Dates must be real dates for time features; zipcode is a category, so averaging it makes no sense.
Exact copies add no information and would bias statistics.

log.action: Kept 177 rows whose id appears more than once
log.reason: The same house sold on different dates is a genuine second sale, not a duplicate record.

log.action: No missing values found - nothing to fill or drop
log.reason: The check is still run so the pipeline works on other versions of the data.

log.action: Added sale_year, sale_month, house_age, is_renovated, has_basement, price_per_sqft, log_price
log.reason: These make patterns easier to see in EDA and are useful inputs for a later prediction model.
yr_built is later than the sale year (house sold before completion); age cannot be negative.

log.action: 1146 rows flagged in column price_outlier, NOT removed
log.reason: Expensive houses are real sales (large, waterfront, luxury). Flagging keeps the information; only impossible values are removed in the validation step.

log.action: Added zipcode_code (integer label for each zipcode)
log.reason: Gives a numeric form of the location for later modelling; the original zipcode is kept.

rules: floors 1-4, condition 1-5, grade 1-13, view 0-4, waterfront 0 or 1
yr_built 1800-2015, yr_renovated 0 or not earlier than yr_built
zipcode must be 5 digits; lat/long inside King County area
